_comment: Single source of truth for the Shopify → members-app webhook contract. shopify/config/catalog.ts imports this file (provisioning registers exactly these topics) and app/tests/unit/webhook-contract.test.ts asserts the members app handles exactly these topics (app/src/lib/billing/shopifyWebhook.ts SHOPIFY_TOPICS_CORE / SHOPIFY_TOPICS_ENRICHMENT). Core topics fire store-wide for any app with the scope (orders/*, refunds/create, disputes/* (read_orders; a lost chargeback revokes access, a won one restores it), customers/*, inventory_levels/update, app/uninstalled). Enrichment topics (subscription_contracts/*, subscription_billing_attempts/*) require read_own_subscription_contracts and fire only for contracts the subscribing app owns (shopify.dev WebhookSubscriptionTopic); with the free Shopify Subscriptions app owning the contracts they never reach us, so they are registered only when SUBSCRIPTION_ENGINE=app and the members app treats them as enrichment, never as the source of truth.
